description: keeps the company to-do list: add an item, read it back, check one off
notes: Drives adws/adw_interface_company_todos.py. Normally bypassed: Toyota reaches the same ADW through CompanyTodoRunner, with no model in the path, and CompanyTodoRoute forces the route for any message naming the to-do list. The list is ~/company_todos/todos.jsonl (COMPANY_TODOS_HOME overrides), append-only, outside the repository. No Write/Edit: the ADW is the only writer.
